svg.aria-label: Twenty-one selected projects by George Heavenson, grouped into Senvon Atelier studio work and independent tooling

g.text: STUDIO WORK — SENVON ATELIER
01 / HOMESWEETHOME
Four-service property platform: a Go core API, a Hono authentication and identity service, a web client and a Flutter app.
Auth handles registration, sessions, tokens and authorization; the Go API carries business logic, data access and integrations.
GO · HONO · TYPESCRIPT · FLUTTER · POSTGRESQL
02 / NAGYIQUE BOUTIQUE
Full e-commerce build for a boutique: Astro storefront, Astro admin portal, and a TypeScript API behind both.
A Next.js platform repo folds API and admin together, so merchandising changes ship without touching the storefront.
ASTRO · NEXT.JS · TYPESCRIPT · REST · E-COMMERCE
03 / SENVON PLATFORM
The studio's own stack — public site, a Hono backend service, and an Astro admin app with Sanity Studio embedded.
Plus a reusable e-commerce template that gives every new client project a working baseline on day one.
ASTRO · HONO · SANITY · TYPESCRIPT · TEMPLATING
04 / GULLIVERS TRAVEL HOTEL
Website for a travel hotel — rooms, amenities and enquiry flow presented for guests deciding where to stay.
Content-driven pages built to stay fast on mobile connections and easy for staff to keep current.
TYPESCRIPT · WEB · HOSPITALITY · CLIENT WORK
05 / ROYAL PARK
Client website build covering brand presentation, service pages and contact routing.
Structured so copy and imagery can be revised without a developer in the loop.
TYPESCRIPT · WEB · CLIENT WORK
06 / MUMMYS DARL EDUCATIONAL CENTRE
Landing site for an educational centre: programmes, admissions information and enquiry capture for parents.
Plain, quick and readable — the audience arrives on phones and wants answers, not animation.
TYPESCRIPT · WEB · EDUCATION · CLIENT WORK
07 / LOBAB KIDS ACADEMY
Landing frontend for a children's academy, replacing an older static site with something maintainable.
Second pass at a client first built years earlier, rebuilt on the studio's current stack.
TYPESCRIPT · WEB · EDUCATION · CLIENT WORK
08 / LUE COSMETICS
Case study for a cosmetics shop: a Go backend with Go templates, paired with a TypeScript storefront.
The largest Go codebase in the studio — product catalogue, cart and order handling behind a styled front end.
GO · GO TEMPLATES · TYPESCRIPT · E-COMMERCE
09 / GATORAID
Most recent studio build, in active development — an even split of Go and TypeScript.
Go services over PostgreSQL with stored procedures, containerised, behind a TypeScript client.
GO · TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · PL/PGSQL · DOCKER
TOOLING & INDEPENDENT
10 / ZOOK
Tiny deploy controller for Docker Compose and native systemd applications — one binary, no agent to babysit.
Released through GoReleaser and installable from a personal Homebrew tap: brew install oti-adjei/tap/zook
GO · GORELEASER · DOCKER COMPOSE · SYSTEMD · HOMEBREW
11 / ARKYT
Scaffolding CLI that generates project boilerplate across tech stacks, starting with Flutter.
Modular command and scaffold packages keep new stacks — Go, Express — additive rather than invasive.
GO · COBRA · CLI · TEMPLATING
12 / PORTFOLIO
Personal portfolio and case-study site — the front door for client work and the projects below.
Component-driven layout with typography-first design, built to load fast and stay easy to extend.
NEXT.JS · TYPESCRIPT · TAILWIND · VERCEL
13 / IVAN THE FOTOGRAPHER
Commissioned portfolio for a working photographer, built around large imagery and fast galleries.
Image-heavy pages tuned for load performance so the work reads first and the interface stays quiet.
TYPESCRIPT · NEXT.JS · IMAGE OPTIMISATION · CLIENT WORK
14 / PAYQUILL
Invoice and receipt generator for small operators who need documents out the door quickly.
Handles line items, totals and export so billing stops being a spreadsheet exercise.
TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · PDF EXPORT · BILLING
15 / CHRYSALIS BLUEPRINT
Automates Discord server creation by generating whole channel, category and role structures.
Turns a repeated hour of manual setup into a declarative blueprint applied in one pass.
TYPESCRIPT · DISCORD API · AUTOMATION
16 / AETHER-CARE
Healthcare management API covering patient records, appointments and clinical workflow endpoints.
Typed service layer with authentication and role separation across clinical and admin access.
TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · REST API · HEALTHCARE
17 / LOANIFY
Loan management system split across a TypeScript backend and a Flutter client.
Backend owns applications, repayment schedules and auth; the mobile app keeps borrowers in the loop.
TYPESCRIPT · DART · FLUTTER · REST
18 / SPOTIFY REDESIGN
Juxtopposed's Spotify concept rebuilt as a working Flutter application rather than a static mockup.
Exercise in translating a strong visual redesign into real widgets, motion and navigation.
DART · FLUTTER · UI ENGINEERING · MOTION
19 / COVIDAPP
Final-year project: a Flutter application for tracking and surfacing COVID-19 information.
Cross-platform build over live data sources with an interface aimed at non-technical users.
FLUTTER · DART · REST · FINAL YEAR PROJECT
20 / BLOODSPOT
Blood donation app built for a friend, taken from a Dribbble concept through to a shipped client.
Paired with a PHP admin panel for managing donors, drives and donation records.
FLUTTER · PHP · MYSQL · ADMIN PANEL
21 / SIMPLE_SHELL · PRINTF · MONTY
Low-level C work: a UNIX shell reimplementation, a printf clone and a stack-based bytecode interpreter.
Where the fundamentals came from — memory management, parsing, syscalls and process control.
C · SYSCALLS · MEMORY MANAGEMENT · ALX
